notes: Stable requirement IDs for every assertion group in docs/TEST-PLAN.md, each mapped to the milestone gate at which it becomes a cumulative requirement. Gate values follow the V0 task order in governance/manifest/v0-task-manifest.json.

requirements.summary: Accept canonical valid fixtures; reject missing, duplicate, unknown, placeholder, and conditionally forbidden packet/receipt/change-set fields.
Reject empty answer sets, duplicate answer IDs, out-of-set recommendation or selection, agent-prepared packet containing a ruling, and free-text, partial, hybrid, or multi-answer receipts.
Reject select without one answer/change set, defer without a revisit trigger/deadline, reject_packet without reason/replacement state, and repack_required without novel-evidence references.
Reject packet, evidence, governing-input, authentication, and required-result digest substitution; reject conflicting active receipts without an explicit supersession chain.
Authentication evidence attests the canonical decision-payload digest; the pinned trust policy controls accepted identities/methods; no authentication object hashes bytes containing its own digest.
Distinct common-policy attestations for the OQ ruling, bootstrap launch, and bootstrap-output acceptance; no decision receipt authenticates a later artifact by implication.

manual-controller-channel-v1 remains the governed-V0 trust root after bootstrap acceptance; later entries pin it; no entry packet or mutable configuration can replace it without a selected and applied transition packet.
defer, reject_packet, repack_required, missing evidence, and unapplied required amendments remain BLOCKED_HUMAN; malformed artifacts or mismatched digests are CONTRACT_INVALID.
A selected receipt satisfies only its declared blocker and never the complete task/slice authorization intersection by itself.
Golden-test the human-readable renderer: it never adds or drops an answer, recommendation, counterevidence, uncertainty, or consequence.
The bootstrap digest graph is acyclic: the positive BUILD.md block pins the contract, the controller-entry packet pins that exact BUILD.md, and no antecedent embeds a descendant digest.

Golden-test the frozen pre-bootstrap verifier: opaque Markdown packet bytes, only the bootstrap trust policy and a selected A/B receipt for V0-G0, frozen change-set/receipt/entry/acceptance grammars, runs outside the candidate checkout, and no G0-generated validator self-approval.

Reject malformed bootstrap scalar types, evidence-reference shapes, non-canonical JSON, receipt/change-set ID disagreement, and an entry or acceptance payload authenticated by the OQ decision's attestation.

The bootstrap entry pins the external frozen-verifier bytes, the exact governance input set, every base path as protected, and the three add-only G0 path patterns; reject broader paths, modified base files, links, special files, traversal, and verifier-digest substitution.

Bootstrap acceptance covers the evidence manifest and every G0 output, includes every mandatory output role, and rejects subsets, extra or unclassified files, duplicate paths, and generated-validator self-approval.
Apply each OQ-7 change set to its exact base in a disposable tree and verify every declared result; reject path, ordering, base, result, receipt-ID, and patch-byte substitutions.
Validate an equivalent post-bootstrap JSON golden under the generated schemas without treating it as retroactive OQ-7 authorization.
Controller-entry, slice-ratification, and human-acceptance receipts pin the required schemas, validator/renderer programs, trust policy, results, and purpose-specific evidence.
A contract_freeze human-acceptance receipt covers D1 execution evidence and every reviewed contract/fixture digest, accepts only the fixed verdicts, and is required before V0-M1.

A slice governance result records only a predeclared receipt ID; the later slice-ratification receipt pins that result tree and the still-later controller entry pins the receipt digest without a cycle.

A current run's evidence never references its future human-acceptance receipt; procedural OQ outcomes cannot supersede an applied selection without a new transition packet, change set, receipt, and governance result.
External evidence write/readback verifies every retained byte; unavailable or altered storage can never return PASS.
Validate DID, DID-authority AT URI, CID, datetime, community identity, exact strong references, allowed collections, and record round trips.
Reject URI-only subjects, handle-authority subjects, non-post subjects, malformed records, community mismatch, and unsupported actions.
Self-submission requires envelope repo DID equal to subject repo DID; no payload field can override it.
Validate the four provisional Lexicons and examples against the local Lexicon validator/model implementation.

Canonical serialization and payload hashes are stable across process runs, mapping order, and supported Python versions; cover dag_cbor, observer_json_v0, delete_envelope_v0; never equate observer JSON hash with record CID.

Keep source event time, observer received_at, and signed createdAt distinct; offset-bearing RFC 3339 normalized to UTC; five-minute skew boundary; future created_at_future handling for profile/submit/admission while storing/checkpointing; future-dated removal still masks and gets the finding; signed time never sets source high-water or custody partition.
Exercise every state and precedence rule in V0-STATE-MACHINE.md.

Cover admission before submission, removal before admission, dependency arrival after pending, wrong community, wrong repo, unverified envelope, unauthorized actor, mismatched admission/submit subjects, and removal of an unknown admission.
Reject external admission whose referenced submission was superseded/deleted before first validation; admission-before-current-submission stays pending until exact resolution.
Accept exact current submission update as a new intent version before admission; admission must reference that exact version.
Valid submission alone never renders; valid admission renders only the exact current CID.
CID mismatch or confirmed deletion terminalizes the admission lifecycle; an exact resolver result after a transient error may recover without new authority.
Unverified/failed mismatch or missing evidence cannot terminalize and maps to subject_unavailable; accepted resolver testimony may terminalize.
Mismatch/deletion found before an externally emitted admission projects directly stale/deleted without flashing visible; a later transport error cannot demote terminal state to subject_unavailable.
A new submission/admission for the new current CID creates a distinct visible lifecycle while the old stale/deleted lifecycle stays in audit.
Admit CID A, observe CID B, revert to A: old lifecycle remains stale; duplicate admission of the old submission cannot revive it; a new A submission/admission may create a visible lifecycle.

Equivalent submissions S1/S2 before mismatch: S2 admitted after revert remains ineligible when its first observed sequence predates terminal state; only later trust-accepted records seed the fresh lifecycle; pending pre-terminal admissions are not held for restoration.
Unverified submission/admission observations before terminal state later corroborated become authentic but retain first-observed sequences and cannot revive the exact subject.
A valid removal masks every duplicate admission for the exact subject and never masks a later different CID.
Collapse semantic duplicate submissions/admissions to one card without losing audit records; earliest (createdAt, admission URI) ordering so duplicates cannot bump chronology.
Reject an occupied deterministic authority rkey with differing content.
Authority record update/delete semantics: admission fails closed; removal cannot be erased into restoration; profile updates remain valid.
Refuse exact-subject readmission after removal; externally observed readmission keeps projected status removed and emits unsupported_readmission separately.
After OQ-5 is decided, lock its submission-update/delete behavior in a named reducer fixture before the state-hardening milestone can pass.

Shuffled cross-repository dependency arrival requires equivalent reference validity; replaying one persisted observation sequence twice yields equivalent lifecycle/current state, findings, pagination, and audit.
Verify fresh schema, each forward migration, newer-schema rejection, indexes/constraints, foreign keys, WAL, bounded busy timeout, and read-only/query-only connections.
Immutable raw event variants, delivery receipts, and subject observations cannot be updated or deleted through application repositories.
Semantic event identity is independent of SQLite rowid, insertion order, source delivery replay, and arrival time.
Canonical rev:<repo-revision> across adapters and ATProto TID ordering; missing/invalid revision goes to immutable quarantine and advances its source cursor atomically without authority effect.
Raw incoming deliveries carry no derived IDs/sequences; only the index writer validates/derives event keys, allocates sequence, and atomically chooses event+receipt versus quarantine+cursor.
Re-delivered identical events are idempotent; same semantic key with a different payload yields a conflict finding, not silent ignore.
One audit row per event_variant_key with semantic key, hash scope, CID, receipts, outcome, and semantic_event_conflict; never pick one conflicting payload as canonical.
Quarantined delivery rows render with stable hash-based audit keys, null semantic/variant identities, raw-envelope hash scope, and rejection reason; pagination never uses SQLite rowid.
An unverified/failed conflicting variant cannot suppress an accepted variant; two incompatible trust-accepted variants fail projection closed.
One semantic event from two sources retains both receipt cursors, times, trust modes, methods/versions, and evidence hashes while projecting once; a later receipt cannot bump audit ordering.
Locally verified, relay-attested, unverified, and failed receipts; only the configured OQ-2 trust policy affects eligibility.
Method/version/evidence provenance preserved on exact, mismatch, missing, and errored subject resolution observations without relabeling.

One global observer sequence allocated transactionally across deliveries, quarantines, and subject observations; admission-triggered check starts the lifecycle; terminal/fresh-intent eligibility applied by sequence with stable keys.

Atomic commit of event variant, delivery receipt, current-record/lifecycle update, projection-build admissibility, and source cursor; injected failure before commit plus restart/replay proves nothing skipped or double-applied.
Resolver network I/O holds no SQLite write transaction; crash between I/O and observation commit keeps the admission pending and never flashes visible.
Full worker queue and held SQLite busy: ingestion applies backpressure or reconnects without dropping/checkpointing an unprocessed event.

At M2, delete only generation-scoped semantic tables and rebuild from the SQLite immutable tail; at M2A repeat after sealed export and verified prefix prune over manifest-listed Parquet history plus the sequence-disjoint SQLite tail with stable-key dedup; content-equivalent results with listed exclusions.
Non-active projection generations marked building/failed; web uses the prior complete active generation and refuses no-active, incompatible, or high-water-mismatched generations.
Simultaneous index writes and read-only web queries without partial generations or long-reader WAL starvation.
Ignore irrelevant collections while retaining malformed relevant records and validation reasons in audit.
Subscribe to the four configured community collections only; never request the global app.bsky.feed.post stream; resolve only subjects reached through submissions/admissions.
Project authority only from the configured community repo and outcomes accepted by the selected trust policy; never relabel relay attestation as local verification.
Unauthorized/unverified admissions and actions stay audit-visible without affecting current state.

Latest authenticity-accepted current profile/self applied by community-repo order; update, delete, malformed, unverified, and missing profile cases fall back to configured slug + community DID/null description without changing admission state.
Return only visible entries in reverse admission chronology with stable, opaque pagination and bounded limits.
404 for an unknown community and 405 for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE.
Escape post/profile/reason text and hostile URIs; prevent script injection, header injection, and path traversal.
Open SQLite read-only, perform no migration or network resolution, and expose schema/projection/freshness health accurately.

Current page/posts return 503 for unavailable/high-water mismatch; health returns the exact 200/503 shape; audit serves the last compatible complete generation with fresh:false and refuses when none exists.
Contract-test every audit outcome/reason code and CLI/API error code; reject unknown reason codes in V0 fixture output.
Stale/degraded banners without leaking internal paths, raw exceptions, configuration, or credentials.
No public API cursor or audit identity contains a SQLite rowid.
Observer sequence is exposed, if at all, only as explicitly local custody order, never as portable event identity.
Reject an unauthorized principal before any reader, credential, or writer call, including effective UID mismatch; actor DID cannot be supplied on the command line.
Admission requires current exact submission and subject, self-submission, matching community, and configured community actor.
Admission payload contains exact submission and subject strong refs plus configured actor attribution.

Admission rkeys derive from exact submission and removal rkeys from exact admission; daemon-owned ledger reader paginates community records by exact subject and makes admission exit 5 after any valid removal without observer access; a new submission before removal may create a new lifecycle.
Removal requires the exact admission and matching embedded subject, permitted when the underlying post is stale or missing.
Repeated semantic operations return the identical record reference; incompatible authority-defining fields at the same rkey fail without overwrite; stored timestamp/reason unchanged on retry.
Read, validation, authorization, credential, and writer failures never report success.
Contract-test exits 0/2/3/4/5/6/7/8, success JSON on stdout only, error JSON on stderr only, and redaction of secrets/raw exceptions.
Writer interface exposes immutable community-record creation only and is never invoked for a user repository.
Logs redact credential values; communityd cannot import or open observer SQLite, Parquet, manifests, or projection cursors.

Build/install each wheel in a clean environment and inspect metadata: no credential/signing/authority-writer/write-client dependency in communitywatch; communityd absent from its graph; writer SDK, DuckDB, PyArrow absent from the watcher closure; archive tool adds DuckDB/PyArrow only with no transport/credential/signing/writer/web/communityd dependency; DuckDB/PyArrow absent from community_model and communityd.
Static imports reject communityd, writer, credential, signing, and authority-client modules anywhere under communitywatch.
Strict config parsers reject writer/credential keys in watcher configuration and observer/database/artifact keys in daemon configuration.
Launch index, web, and daemon as separate subprocesses with isolated temp roots and allow-listed environments; only the daemon receives a fake credential reference.
Web cannot mutate SQLite and the watcher cannot invoke the fake authority writer even when daemon-related environment variables are present.

Offline vertical acceptance over fake transports and one temporary observer SQLite database: hidden submission, admission visibility at exact URI+CID, CID-mismatch hiding, removal persistence, compact audit retention, no system mutation of the user post, and rebuild parity from current immutable custody.
Archive tooling installs separately; base index/web and communityd environments neither acquire nor import it.

Close an observer-sequence prefix and per-source high-waters without holding an ingest read snapshot; export receipts, quarantines, and subject observations while a later occurrence stays in the SQLite tail.
Partition principally by trusted observer received_at, never actor-supplied or source time; reference deduplicated payload variants from compact receipts.

Receipts/observations for one event variant and one subject variant on both sides of the cut; variants retained while referenced; stable-key dedup of intentional hot/cold overlap during query and rebuild.
Staged export, rename, or durability failure leaves the prior sealed generation and SQLite source detail untouched; recovery quarantines/cleans an unsealed stage.
Failure after sealed publication but before last-good pointer acceptance keeps the prior pointer unchanged and recovers without silently changing consumers.
Target deployment filesystem rename/crash behavior is tested, not assumed.

Artifact schema/bytes, row count, min/max observer time and sequence, per-source high-waters, and manifest agree before sealing; hot/cold parity and rebuild pass before accepting the generation and switching the last-good pointer.

Failure writing the acceptance receipt, switching the pointer, or reconciling SQLite archive-control state leaves the prior pointer accepted or recovers idempotently; pruning is never permitted while the three disagree.
Partial/missing partitions, late arrivals, quarantine, supersession, and schema-version rejection are explicit rather than inferred from file presence.

Retention refuses before seal, parity, rebuild, acceptance receipt, pointer switch, and SQLite-control reconciliation; injected prune failure rolls back exact-prefix deletion and its prune coordinate; retry is idempotent.
Pruning deletes only covered occurrence rows; retains a payload variant while any tail row references it; garbage-collects only after the final reference is covered.
Rebuild from accepted history plus sequence-disjoint tail byte-compares semantically with the pre-prune audit/projection; rejects occurrence gaps/overlap; permits only stable-key variant overlap.
DuckDB and pre-export SQLite queries have fixture parity over duplicate, conflicting, quarantined, late, and high-cardinality/non-deduplicating data.
Cold queries open no hot SQLite handle, stream bounded partition/horizon results under an external process memory ceiling, and build no unbounded in-memory identity map.
Artifact receipts confer no admission/moderation authority; communityd cannot open the database/artifacts/manifests; web requests remain SQLite-only after pruning.
